## Checklist

- [ ] `yarn test`, `yarn typecheck` and `yarn lint` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Props documented (run `yarn docs:props` for new components) and the showcase example updated
- [ ] No breaking change, or the PR title/description says so and the migration is described
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...)
